run_create_vasp_inputs_cli: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI to generate VASP input files from a directory of CIF crystal structure files
run_create_vasp_inputs_relax: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI with type relax to generate tight relaxation VASP inputs from CIF files
run_create_vasp_inputs_static: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI with type static to generate static VASP inputs from CIF files
create_input_generator_relax: create a RelaxSetGenerator with PBE_54_W_HASH functional and auto kspacing from an incar YAML config file
create_input_generator_static: create a StaticSetGenerator with PBE_54_W_HASH functional and auto kspacing from an incar YAML config file
